case.name: UMUOJI
case.summary: Five wells on a 50 m grid with a 600 m extrapolation limit and a 2120 m contact; a sealing fault at 1600 m; five well porosities that improve downdip, so the trend model removes barrels. The crest at Umuoji-2 is base limited.
